        raise TokenExchangeError("invalid_request", "Missing requested audience (audience parameter).")

    if requested_aud not in VALID_AUDIENCES:

        self.error = error
        self.description = description
        super().__init__(f"{error}: {description}")

    """Decode base64url encoded string."""
    rem = len(input_str) % 4
    if rem > 0:

    return base64.urlsafe_b64decode(input_str)


def _base64url_encode(input_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    """Encode bytes to base64url string."""
    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(input_bytes).rstrip(b"=").decode("utf-8")

    parts = token.split(".")

    signature_b64 = _base64url_encode(signature)
